excerpt.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队试图劫掠我们的领土，但在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被全歼了。舰船残骸中没有发现任何幸存者。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] fleet that vowed to raid our space has been destroyed as the result of a fleet action in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system. No survivors have been reported found amongst the debris.

texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]的劫掠舰队试图劫掠我们的领土，但在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被全歼了。舰船残骸中没有发现任何幸存者。
texts.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] fleet that vowed to raid our space has been destroyed as the result of a fleet action in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system. No survivors have been reported found amongst the debris.

label.zh: 让这次惨败作为他们的教训吧。
label.en: Let this be a lesson to their kind.

texts.zh: 在我们的唆使下，[raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所组成的私掠舰队在[destroyed_fleet_system.GetName]星系被[fleet_destroyer.GetName]摧毁了！没有幸存者的相关报告。
texts.en: The raiding fleet that we "encouraged" the [raiding_marauder.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put together has been destroyed in the [destroyed_fleet_system.GetName] system by forces belonging to the [fleet_destroyer.GetName]! There are no reports of survivors.

label.zh: 希望他们在被消灭前给敌人造成了一些伤害。
label.en: They hopefully did some damage at least.
